evidence_scope: Read-only extraction of existing native CARC A100 frozen-checkpoint comparisons, with separately labeled initial cloud CPU smoke controls. No model executed, trained, selected or numerically re-evaluated.

native_a100_protocol_and_metric_definiti.scope: Finite diagnostic development comparison of local neural implementations; no published SOTA claim or overall ranking.
native_a100_protocol_and_metric_definiti.cost_scope: Complete rollout wall time on the same device, including features, network, physics and state checks; training cost is separate.
native_a100_protocol_and_metric_definiti.accuracy_scope: Speed uses the declared fixed-tolerance feasible frontier. Same-h and heldout errors include finite completed trajectories regardless of tolerance; failures and absence are explicit.
native_a100_protocol_and_metric_definiti.selection_scope: Post-hoc fastest feasible declared-grid point per diagnostic parent, not a deployable step selector; checkpoints selected on validation only.
native_a100_protocol_and_metric_definiti.coverage_scope: Parents and expected horizon grids are inferred from all supplied rows; entirely unobserved parents cannot be inferred.
native_a100_protocol_and_metric_definiti.tie_rule: Error and speed ties use relative tolerance 1e-12 and absolute tolerance 1e-15; not a statistical significance test.
native_a100_protocol_and_metric_definiti.error_details: Exact paired horizon errors, invalid statuses and messages remain in frontier.json and heldout.json; summary counts never omit failed or absent observations.
native_a100_protocol_and_metric_definiti.error_count_scope: Per-parent pairs report RMS counts; per-family aggregates additionally report uncertainty-adjusted upper-error counts. Missing and failed side counts can overlap on one pair.
native_a100_protocol_and_metric_definiti.budget_scope: Finite declared grids, parent-disjoint data and equal optimizer-step budgets; parameter counts and architectures are reported rather than matched. No extra baseline tuning or classical-headroom requirement.

native_a100_training.failure_reason: No checkpoint had admissible finite validation trajectories
